messages:
infra-jay: FYI apiserver errors spiking in eu-west1 after the A100 node pool onboarding. Seeing a ton of kubelet re-registers and label churn, watch fanout skyrocketing.

oncall-bot: ALERT eu-west1 apiserver 429s/5m; etcd leader write latency >200ms (alerting).
sre-elaine: grabbing logs. are pods stuck in Pending or crashing?
infra-jay: pending + long create times. HPA scaleups are timing out. autoscaler shows: 
```
I082 12:02:14.123 node_controller.go:300] Node "gpunode-7" re-registered, labels changed
E082 12:02:16.987 apiserver.go:451] watch closed: too many open watches (queue_len=512)
etcd: WAL fsync latency=250ms, commit=300ms
```

runtime-ops: sounds like the node-label churn causes controllers to re-list -> apiserver watch fanout. that + etcd fsync blips = cascade.
eng-tariq: Is this correlated with the new node image? We rolled a taint/label change script in onboarding job yesterday.
prod-sre: Confirmed: cloudprovider agent applied label set: `gpu.vendor/redwood=A100-v2` in a loop when node metadata API was slow. That caused continuous UpdateNode calls.
sre-elaine: Nice find. UpdateNode churn -> watch events blow up, controller-manager lease renewals queue. We should throttle updates and stop the rollout.
infra-jay: I'm pausing the nodepool rollout (cloud console). Also kicking kubelet to stop label writer on those nodes: `systemctl stop redwood-node-autotag` on impacted nodes.
eng-tariq: For immediate relief, can we increase apiserver max-requests-inflight and kube-apiserver request-timeout?
runtime-ops: Suggestion: temporary flags: `--max-requests-inflight=2000` and `--max-mutating-requests-inflight=300` for region apiservers, and bump etcd snapshot/compaction interval later. But increased inflight only masks root cause.
prod-sre: While infra-jay stops the process, I'll shift writes off leader by forcing etcd leader transfer to a node with faster disk.
oncall-bot: runbook reminder: https://wiki/internal/runbooks/apiserver-watch-fanout.
sre-elaine: Also lowering controller-manager's leaseDuration to reduce queueing? That might increase churn, not help. Instead, extend leaseDuration to reduce needless elections: `--leader-elect-lease-duration=60s` -> currently 15s.
eng-tariq: Cost note: if we need to resize etcd to higher IOPS or migrate to bigger disks that'll increase monthly infra cost ~+25% for that region. Put on cost queue if needed.
infra-jay: Quick mitigation steps applied: paused rollout (done), stopped autotag service on 12 nodes, increased apiserver inflight on eu-west1 control plane, forced etcd leader transfer, and disabled autoscaler scaleups in that region.
prod-sre: Observability: token-level latency and per-route traces show drop in create latency from 4500ms -> 700ms after actions.
eng-tariq: Follow-ups: 1) fix node onboarding script to handle metadata timeouts (retry backoff + one-shot label write). 2) add HA guardrail: reject >5 node label updates/min per-node. 3) Add a controller backpressure metric in Console.
sre-elaine: Also add unit test for label writer to avoid infinite loops when cloud metadata returns transient 500s.
runtime-ops: I'll file a short postmortem and include the config diff and the cost impact estimate.
infra-jay: Thx everyone. I'll keep this thread updated if anything regresses.
prod-sre: closing loop: by 12:48 UTC last spike removed. marking incident as mitigated.
eng-tariq: We should schedule a change window to patch the onboarding job and run soak tests before re-enabling the pool.
prod-sre: Agreed — change planned for tomorrow 02:00 UTC with canary on 2 nodes.
infra-jay: TL;DR: root cause = onboarding label writer retry loop + slow metadata API -> UpdateNode churn -> watch fanout amplification -> etcd fsync pressure -> apiserver/controller-manager latency. Mitigations = pause rollout, stop label writer, increase inflight temporarily, transfer etcd leader, plan code fix and guards.
